item.title: United States wins Olympic gold medal in women's hockey, defeating Canada 2-1
item.description: United States wins its third Olympic gold medal in women's hockey, beating Canada 2-1 on Megan Keller's goal in overtime.

item.title: Michigan OKs $242M rate increase for DTE
item.description: The Michigan Public Service Commission has approved a $242.4 million rate hike for DTE Electric Co., which will raise a typical residential customer's monthly bill by about $4.93, or 4.6%, while also approving $17.8 million for new electric vehicle charging infrastructure and imposing several oversight and consumer-protection measures.

item.title: MSU's FRIB boosts U.S. capacity for radiation chip testing
item.description: Michigan State University has inaugurated the K500 Chip Testing Facility, which will help make microchips more reliable in high-radiation environments and increase U.S. capacity for radiation effects testing on advanced microelectronics.

item.title: UM Health-Sparrow plans new mental health, surgery center
item.description: UM Health-Sparrow is expanding its Lansing campus with the construction of a 64-bed behavioral health hospital and an ambulatory surgery center, which will help address the region's mental health crisis and provide lower-cost surgical care.
